page.title: Notifications
page.intro: Alerts from Polaris and your integrations, and where each one is sent.

errors.notSavedTryAgain: That could not be saved. Try again.
errors.destinationGone: One of those destinations no longer exists.
errors.tooManyTests: Too many tests. Wait a moment before sending another.

inGame.title: Messages in Minecraft
inGame.description: While you play on a server here, your Chat messages also appear in its game chat. Only you see them.
inGame.descriptionWith: While you play on a server here, your Chat messages also appear in its game chat. Only you see them. {hint}.
inGame.label: Which Chat messages to show in Minecraft while I play

hints.auto: Direct messages and groups of up to {size} people
hints.all: Every conversation, channels and large groups included

inGame.notReady: No server knows which player is you yet. Add your Minecraft username in Connected accounts, or ask whoever runs the server to link your player to your account.

browser.title: Browser notifications

standing.app: The Polaris app draws these itself. Nothing to allow.
standing.granted: Polaris can tell you about these while you are on another tab.
standing.denied: This browser is blocking them. Allow notifications for this site in its settings to turn them back on.
standing.askable: Let Polaris tell you about a call or a message while you are on another tab.

browser.testBody: This is what a notice from Polaris looks like.
browser.testSent: Sent. If nothing appeared, the system is holding it back - check its own notification settings.
browser.testRefused: This browser would not draw it.

calls.title: Calls
calls.hint: Somebody calling you. The one that rings.

messages.title: Chat messages
messages.hint: A message in a conversation you follow, while you are on another tab.

mail.title: Mail
mail.hint: Something arriving in a mailbox you read here.

alerts.title: Everything else
alerts.hint: A finished build, a server that stopped, anything the bell would carry.

browser.keptHere: These are kept for this browser, not for your account - the same as the sound below. What reaches the bell, your mail and everything else is further down.

sound.title: Sound
sound.description: Play a chime when a notification or message arrives. Kept on this device.
sound.label: Play a sound when a notification arrives
sound.volumeNotSaved: Could not save the volume. Try again.
sound.volumeHint: For every Polaris sound: alerts, messages and calls. Saved to your account.

tabIcon.title: Tab icon
tabIcon.label: What the tab icon shows when something is waiting

count.label: Count
count.hint: How many are waiting, on the tab icon.

dot.label: Dot
dot.hint: A dot on the tab icon, without the number.

none.label: Nothing
none.hint: The plain icon, whatever is waiting.

rules.securityAlways: Security alerts always appear in Polaris

destinations.title: Destinations
destinations.description: Webhooks and phone numbers you can route the events above to.
destinations.empty: No destinations yet. Add a Discord or Slack webhook, or a number for texts.
destinations.smsNotReady: Texts will not send until an SMS sender is connected under <link>Channels</link>.

dialog.title: Add a destination
dialog.description: Somewhere alerts can go. Point events at it once it is added.
dialog.name: Name
dialog.urlHint: Discord, Slack, Teams, or a Telegram bot as {example}. Anyone with this URL can post to the channel, so it is stored encrypted and never shown again.
dialog.numberHint: International form, including the country code.

deliveries.title: Recent deliveries
deliveries.description: Every attempt to get an alert somewhere, and how it went.

deployFailed.label: Deploy failed
deployFailed.description: A build or deploy of a service or database did not come up.

deploySucceeded.label: Deploy succeeded
deploySucceeded.description: A service or database finished deploying and is serving.

cronFailed.label: A scheduled job failed
cronFailed.description: A service's scheduled command failed on its last try, or ran out of time.

domainDown.label: A domain stopped serving
domainDown.description: A domain pointed at one of your services stopped answering.

domainUp.label: A domain started serving again
domainUp.description: A domain that had stopped answering is reachable again.

billingBudget.label: An organization's budget is running out
billingBudget.description: What an organization you run spent this month reached 80% of its budget, or went past it.

tasksAssigned.label: Assigned a task
tasksAssigned.description: Somebody put a task in your name, or a rule did.

tasksShared.label: A task sent to you
tasksShared.description: Somebody sent you a task to look at.

tasksComment.label: Comment on your work
tasksComment.description: A comment on a task you are assigned to or watching.

tasksMentioned.label: Mentioned by name
tasksMentioned.description: Somebody wrote your name into a task, a comment or a page.

tasksDue.label: Task reminder
tasksDue.description: A reminder you set on a task, and work falling due today.

calendarReminder.label: Event reminder
calendarReminder.description: A reminder set on an event or a task in your calendars.

calendarClock.label: Alarm or timer went off
calendarClock.description: An alarm or a timer you set in Calendar's Time area went off.

calendarInvitation.label: Invitation
calendarInvitation.description: Somebody invited you to an event, or changed or cancelled one you are in.

calendarReply.label: Invitation answered
calendarReply.description: Somebody accepted, declined or answered maybe to an event you organized.

calendarShared.label: Calendar shared with you
calendarShared.description: Somebody shared one of their calendars with you or with a team you are in.

calendarBooking.label: New booking
calendarBooking.description: Somebody booked, moved or cancelled time on one of your booking pages.

calendarProposal.label: Proposal answered
calendarProposal.description: Somebody voted on the times of a meeting you proposed.

calendarSyncFailed.label: A linked calendar stopped syncing
calendarSyncFailed.description: A calendar you linked from Google, Microsoft or a CalDAV server refused Polaris or could not be reached.

watchAlarm.label: Alarm fired
watchAlarm.description: A watched service, domain or resource breached its condition.

watchOk.label: Alarm cleared
watchOk.description: A watched target came back within its condition.

domainSecurity.label: A domain's security got worse
domainSecurity.description: A daily check found a domain you manage open to spoofing, about to expire, or newly misconfigured.

accountSignin.label: Sign-in waiting for approval
accountSignin.description: Someone signed in to your account and needs approving.

accountRecovery.label: Someone locked out of their account
accountRecovery.description: A request to reset a password is waiting for a decision.

accountSessionOpened.label: A session was opened
accountSessionOpened.description: Your account was signed in to, and from where.

accountSessionClosed.label: A session ended
accountSessionClosed.description: A device was signed out, by you or by something else.

accountSessionCompromised.label: A session was used by somebody else
accountSessionCompromised.description: A session of yours was used from a device or an address it is not tied to, and was ended.

adminSafetyCase.label: Something needs an administrator
adminSafetyCase.description: An account locked itself down, or somebody reported a person or a message. Only reaches administrators.

accountLinkSuggested.label: Linking an account you already have
accountLinkSuggested.description: Your address belongs to a service Polaris can sign you in with, and linking it would prove the address and give you a way in that is not a password.

accountFriend.label: Friend requests
accountFriend.description: Somebody asked to be added, or answered a request you sent.

chatCallMissed.label: Missed calls
chatCallMissed.description: Somebody called you and nobody picked it up.

accountOrgInvite.label: Organization invitations
accountOrgInvite.description: You were invited to an organization, or somebody accepted yours.

accountSecurity.label: Account security changed
accountSecurity.description: A password, a second factor, a passkey, a key or a sign-in rule changed.

accountConnectionExpired.label: A connected account stopped working
accountConnectionExpired.description: A token you linked ran out or was withdrawn, and what it was doing has stopped.

accountConnectionScopes.label: A connected account needs authorizing again
accountConnectionScopes.description: Polaris now asks a service for more than it did when you linked your account, and it cannot use the new part until you approve it.

accountAiKeyExpiring.label: An AI provider key is about to expire
accountAiKeyExpiring.description: A key you gave an end date runs out within the week.

accountAiKeyExpired.label: An AI provider key expired
accountAiKeyExpired.description: A key reached its end date and is no longer used by anything.

driveDropPointReceived.label: Something arrived at a drop point
driveDropPointReceived.description: A file or a piece of text was sent to one of your drop points.

scanDetection.label: Malware in an upload
scanDetection.description: A file sent to one of your drop points was flagged.

scanError.label: Upload could not be scanned
scanError.description: The scanner did not finish. The file was kept.

placesSighting.label: A camera saw something
placesSighting.description: Somebody, a vehicle, an animal or a parcel came into view of a camera.

placesAlert.label: An alert you wrote went off
placesAlert.description: Something one of your alerts asked about happened.

placesTamper.label: A camera was interfered with
placesTamper.description: A camera reported being covered, moved or unplugged.

placesOffline.label: A camera stopped answering
placesOffline.description: A camera went quiet, or came back after being quiet.

placesAutomation.label: An automation told you something
placesAutomation.description: A step in one of your automations asked to let you know.

serverSpace.label: A server is running out of room
serverSpace.description: Polaris freed everything nothing was using and the disk is still nearly full.

mailserverInbound.label: Mail matched a rule
mailserverInbound.description: A message arrived at a mail server you run and matched one of its rules.

mailserverAttention.label: A mail server needs attention
mailserverAttention.description: A mail server you run stopped answering, or answers again.

mailAccountRefused.label: A mailbox stopped accepting its password
mailAccountRefused.description: A mailbox you connected refused its password or authorization, and Polaris paused checking it until you update it.

mailMessageBounced.label: A message you sent did not arrive
mailMessageBounced.description: A delivery report came back about something you sent, saying it never reached the address it was for.

mailMessageUnsent.label: A message could not be sent
mailMessageUnsent.description: The outgoing server refused a message for good, or refused it for some of the people it was for.

mailMessageUncopied.label: Sent messages are not being copied to Sent
mailMessageUncopied.description: Your mail is going out, but the mail server would not keep a copy of it in your Sent folder.

networkRouter.label: Network needs attention
networkRouter.description: Something outside Polaris is stopping your services being reached.

networkAddress.label: An address stopped answering
networkAddress.description: One of the addresses this Polaris is reachable at went down, or came back.

integrationAttention.label: An integration needs attention
integrationAttention.description: A service somebody tried to connect an account of refused the authorization.

systemUpdate.label: Update available
systemUpdate.description: A new Polaris build is published and ready to install.

systemUpdated.label: Update installed on its own
systemUpdated.description: A scheduled or automatic update ran, and how it went.

storageUnreachable.label: Upload storage is not reachable
storageUnreachable.description: The storage files are saved to stopped answering, so new uploads are kept on this server. Only reaches administrators.

storageMoved.label: Storage moved to a new address
storageMoved.description: A NAS took a new address on the local network and Polaris found it and follows it. Only reaches administrators.

badges.title: Clear badges when I open the screen
badges.label: Clear a badge when I open its screen
badges.onHint: An update or a report stops counting once you have opened its screen. Something new counts again.
badges.offHint: Badges stay until the work is done: the update installed, the report settled.
